claims.claim: The registry contains the five Brain-owned contracts in canonical order, with Flow Card metadata, provider-facing candidate shapes, requirements, and explicit Decision Packet or external request bindings.

The pure module enforces closed v1 grammar and bounds, rejects malformed material, and hashes normalized selected contract material with effective bounds so mapping order and LF/CRLF differences preserve identity.
Selection rejects Decision Packet metadata substitution; representative TASK, REMEDIATION, and REPAIR fixtures were accepted through their existing canonical validators.
The commit changes only the three TASK-authorized files and adds no provider invocation, ingress control, lifecycle routing, or candidate family validator.
